about.subtitle: Get to know me
about.bio1: Hello! I'm <1>Lê Hoàng Quách Tỉnh</1>. I engineer the unseen foundation of digital products.
about.bio2: My expertise lies in architecting resilient backend systems, orchestrating microservices, and optimizing complex data flows. I don't just write code; I build infrastructure that scales effortlessly under pressure while remaining remarkably easy to maintain and secure.
about.card1Desc: Deconstructing complexity into scalable, isolated systems.
about.card3Desc: Building robust, scalable, and secure APIs.

1.title: Real-time Auction Platform
1.desc: A high-performance real-time online auction system. Capable of handling continuous live bidding, millisecond-precision countdowns, and instant broadcast of auction results.

2.title: RideBook
2.desc: Backend architecture for an online ride-booking platform. Engineered to support real-time GPS tracking, smart driver-passenger matching algorithms, and secure payment processing.

3.title: E-Commerce Microservices
3.desc: An e-commerce platform based on a highly scalable microservices architecture. It encompasses secure authentication, dynamic product catalogs, and robust order management systems.

4.title: English Learning App
4.desc: Cross-platform English learning application built on a gamification model. Features include real-time progress tracking, a virtual shop system, and AI-driven learning support.
